title: VersaPRM: Multi-Domain Process Reward Model via Synthetic Reasoning Data
authors_zh: Thomas Zeng、Shuibai Zhang、Shutong Wu、Christian Classen 等（威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校、高丽大学、FuriosaAI、加州大学伯克利分校）
paper_type_zh: 合成过程监督数据发布与多领域过程奖励模型研究
best_for_zh: 适合构建过程标签、奖励模型或非狭义数学任务测试时搜索系统的读者。
one_line: VersaPRM creates and releases multi-domain step-labeled reasoning traces, then trains a process reward model that improves test-time selection beyond mathematics.
VersaPRM 构造并发布多领域、带步骤标签的推理轨迹，再训练过程奖励模型，使测试时选择能力扩展到数学以外的领域。
why: It demonstrates that diversity and label construction in process data determine where a reward model remains useful, not merely which optimizer is applied.
inclusion_reason: It makes synthetic trace generation, process-label construction, and the reward-model training consumer a single reproducible multi-domain pipeline.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Process reward models can score intermediate reasoning steps and improve test-time selection, but available open models have been trained mostly on mathematical traces. Their usefulness in law, biology, philosophy, or other knowledge-intensive reasoning is therefore uncertain; a model that ranks algebra steps well may not recognize an unsupported legal or scientific inference.

VersaPRM asks how to make process supervision useful across domains without commissioning human labels for every reasoning trace. It addresses the problem by constructing a multi-domain dataset of generated chains of thought with step labels, then trains a reward model whose scores can choose or search among multiple candidate solutions.

过程奖励模型能够给中间推理步骤打分并改善测试时选择，但现有开放模型大多只在数学轨迹上训练。它们在法律、生物、哲学或其他知识密集型推理中的作用因而并不确定；一个能排序代数步骤的模型未必能识别没有依据的法律或科学推断。

VersaPRM 询问，如何在不为每条推理轨迹委托人工标注的情况下，让过程监督跨领域发挥作用。它通过构造带步骤标签的多领域生成思维链数据集来解决这一问题，再训练一个奖励模型，用其分数在多个候选解答之间进行选择或搜索。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The key design decision is to treat domain diversity as part of the reward-model training signal. Instead of adapting a mathematical process model with more mathematics, the authors draw questions from fourteen MMLU-Pro domains, generate several explanations per question, and create labels that locate the first bad step in each explanation.

The resulting record preserves both positive and negative process supervision. Steps before the first detected error are retained as correct, the first error is marked incorrect, and later steps are discarded because they may merely inherit the earlier failure. A process reward model learns from those local labels and then aggregates them to rank whole solutions.

关键的设计决策是把领域多样性视为奖励模型训练信号的一部分。作者并不只是用更多数学数据适配数学过程模型，而是从 MMLU-Pro 的十四个领域抽取问题，为每个问题生成若干解释，并建立能定位每段解释中第一个错误步骤的标签。

得到的记录同时保留正向和负向的过程监督。第一个检测到的错误之前的步骤被保留为正确，第一个错误被标为不正确，之后的步骤则被丢弃，因为它们可能只是继承了先前的失败。过程奖励模型从这些局部标签中学习，再聚合它们来排序完整解答。

title: Method
方法
html:
The pipeline samples up to 500 MMLU-Pro questions per domain, separately from evaluation questions, and asks Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct for 16 step-separated chains of thought per question. It removes traces over 2,048 tokens or without a parsable answer. Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct then sees the question, reference answer, and trace, and applies explicit GOOD, OK, BAD criteria to identify the earliest bad step.

After filtering, the release contains 84,098 traces and 487,380 steps. The final model starts from LlamaPRM800K and uses LoRA for one epoch, with a classification loss only at a special token appended to each step. At use time, its step probabilities are aggregated by minimum, last, or average score for weighted majority voting, best-of-N, beam search, or Monte Carlo tree search.

该流程从每个 MMLU-Pro 领域抽取最多 500 个问题，并与评测问题分开，再要求 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 为每题生成 16 条按步骤分隔的思维链。它移除超过 2,048 个词元或无法解析答案的轨迹。随后 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 读取问题、参考答案和轨迹，并按明确的 GOOD、OK、BAD 标准识别最早的错误步骤。

过滤后，发布内容包含 84,098 条轨迹和 487,380 个步骤。最终模型从 LlamaPRM800K 开始，用 LoRA 训练一个轮次，并且只在附于每个步骤末尾的特殊词元上计算分类损失。使用时，它的步骤概率通过最小、末步或平均分数聚合，服务于加权多数投票、最佳 N 选一、束搜索或蒙特卡洛树搜索。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The authors manually inspect 64 randomly sampled questions, selecting one all-correct trace and two error-containing traces per question. The automatic labels agree with their judgments 80 percent of the time for traces marked correct and 71 percent for traces marked incorrect; they estimate roughly 75 percent label accuracy overall. Removing both label definitions and reference answers drops the correct-trace agreement from 80 percent to 7 percent on their re-evaluated subset.

With 16 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct candidates and minimum-score weighted majority voting, VersaPRM reaches 61.22 accuracy overall on MMLU-Pro-CoT-Eval, a 4.07-point gain over majority voting. The non-math aggregate rises by 3.68 points, and law rises from 35.93 to 43.86, a 7.93-point gain; Qwen-2.5-Math-PRM improves law by only 0.35 points in the same table.

作者人工检查了随机抽取的 64 个问题，每题选择一条被视为完全正确的轨迹和两条含错误的轨迹。对于标为正确的轨迹，自动标签与其判断有 80% 的一致率；对于标为错误的轨迹，一致率为 71%；他们估计总体标签准确率约为 75%。在重新评估的子集上，同时移除标签定义和参考答案会使正确轨迹的一致率从 80% 降至 7%。

在每题有 16 个 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 候选且使用最小分数加权多数投票时，VersaPRM 在 MMLU-Pro-CoT-Eval 上的总体准确率为 61.22，比多数投票高 4.07 个点。非数学汇总提高 3.68 个点，法律从 35.93 提高到 43.86，即提高 7.93 个点；同一张表中 Qwen-2.5-Math-PRM 对法律只提高 0.35 个点。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior process-reward work made mathematical traces the default substrate and often treated the trained verifier as the primary contribution. VersaPRM moves the design attention to the training record: it combines domain-balanced question selection, multiple generated traces, reference-conditioned earliest-error judgments, and prefix truncation into an openly released construction recipe.

It also evaluates the consequence of that record design rather than only reporting one model. Random multi-domain subsets outperform equally sized math-only subsets, and held-out-domain experiments remain close to the full model. Those tests support the narrower claim that diversity changes the learned process judgment, rather than merely exposing the reward model to the benchmark's question format.

先前的过程奖励研究把数学轨迹当作默认基质，并常将训练后的验证器视为主要贡献。VersaPRM 将设计注意力转向训练记录：它把领域平衡的问题选择、多条生成轨迹、以参考答案为条件的最早错误判断和前缀截断组合成一个公开发布的构造配方。

它还评估了这种记录设计的后果，而不只是报告一个模型。随机多领域子集优于规模相同的仅数学子集，留出领域实验的表现也接近完整模型。这些检验支持了一个更窄的主张：多样性改变了学到的过程判断，而不只是让奖励模型接触到基准的问题格式。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The supervisory judge is itself a Llama model and the manual check estimates imperfect labels, so errors or style preferences can be inherited by the released process data. The model still misses factual and arithmetic mistakes in the paper's examples, and the authors report that one-step PRM-guided refinement reduces pass-at-one from 51 percent to 45 percent. The evaluation is largely multiple-choice MMLU-Pro and requires multiple sampled traces at inference, so it is not evidence that the method universally improves open-ended reasoning or reduces serving cost.
监督评审器本身是一个 Llama 模型，而人工检查估计标签并不完美，因此错误或风格偏好可能被继承到发布的过程数据中。论文示例显示模型仍会漏掉事实和算术错误，作者还报告一次由过程奖励模型引导的改写会把单次通过率从 51% 降至 45%。评测主要是多选的 MMLU-Pro，并且推理时需要采样多条轨迹，因此它不能证明该方法普遍改善开放式推理或降低服务成本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this card when designing a process-supervision dataset intended to serve several domains, not only a single benchmark. The public dataset exposes question, reference answer, trace, step labels, and parsed outcome, while the repository includes generation, augmentation, training, evaluation, and search scripts. That makes it a practical reference for deciding where a trace is cut, what a negative step means, and how an inference-time consumer aggregates local rewards.
当设计一个服务于多个领域而非单一基准的过程监督数据集时，可使用这张卡。公开数据集暴露了问题、参考答案、轨迹、步骤标签和解析后的结果，仓库还包含生成、增强、训练、评测和搜索脚本。因此它是决定何处截断轨迹、负向步骤意味着什么，以及推理时消费者如何聚合局部奖励的实用参考。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the paper in the order of its dataset recipe, not its search algorithms: inspect the question split, 16-trace sampling, earliest-error label conversion, manual-label audit, and LoRA objective before interpreting the reranking curves. For reuse, validate the judge on each target domain, store the original trace and judge rationale with every label, and compare a diverse mixture with a same-size single-domain control; the paper's own ablations show that this comparison is central to its claim.
应按数据集配方而非搜索算法的顺序阅读这篇论文：在解释重排序曲线前，先检查问题划分、16 条轨迹采样、最早错误标签转换、人工标签审计和 LoRA 目标。复用时，应在每个目标领域验证评审器，为每个标签保存原始轨迹和评审理由，并将多样化混合与同规模单领域对照比较；论文自身的消融表明，这个比较是其主张的核心。
